_comment: Repo-convention invariants that reduce to a path check: files that must not exist, and files that must. Each entry cites the invariant it enforces, so a failure names the rule rather than just the path. The invariant text lives in .agent/invariants.md.

forbidden.why: Tailwind v4 is CSS-first and reads its config from globals.css. A JS config is silently ignored — it misleads the next reader instead of erroring.
